name: rnby-racp-public-workspace
description: Standalone, transport-neutral packages for the Remote Agent Communication Protocol (RACP).
author: RnBy

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:examples && npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:python
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @rnby/racp-codec && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @rnby/racp-client && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @rnby/racp-bridge && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @rnby/racp-agent
